protocol: research_v3 sector_mom HYBRID: frozen CAP_DEF_M allocation layer with sector-momentum equity selection; one-time holdout test
question: Inside the frozen CAP_DEF_M allocation framework on the CN universe, does replacing the broad equity ETF(s) it selects with 12-1 sector momentum ETFs improve risk-adjusted return in the holdout period?

exposure_disclosure.already_seen_for_this_window: Returns of CAP_DEF_M on the 6-ETF CN universe, CSI300 (510300), CN_60_40, gold (518880) and bonds (511010) were reported in research_v3/cn_transfer (commit 2078682). The allocation layer's behaviour in the holdout is therefore NOT unseen.
exposure_disclosure.not_yet_seen: Any sector ETF return or sector-momentum result after 2024-09-30 (guarded by research_v3/sector_mom/guard.py).
exposure_disclosure.consequence: The test is clean only for the incremental question (HYBRID vs CAP_DEF_M_CN). Comparisons with CSI300_BH and CN_60_40 are reported but are not clean out-of-sample evidence.

components_all_previously_fixed.allocation_layer: Frozen CAP_DEF_M rule exactly as implemented in research_v3/cn_transfer (6-ETF universe, groups, momentum 12m, trend 40w, top 3, cap one per group, DEF slots with 511010 vs SHIBOR cash, matched-monthly schedule, amendment-1 suspension handling).
components_all_previously_fixed.sector_selection: S5_IND_MOM_12_1 score from research_v3/sector_mom amendment 1 (adjusted close 21 sessions before signal / 252 sessions before signal - 1), eligibility with at least 253 sessions of bars, 60-session mean turnover >= 30,000,000 CNY, bar on the signal date, dedup by tracked index keeping the highest-turnover ETF; universe = the classified sector list (sha256 64bc28ed7a49...eaaf).

hybrid_rule.timing: At each CAP_DEF_M monthly signal session (the cn_transfer matched-monthly schedule), compute the CAP_DEF_M target weights. Trades execute at that schedule's execution session open.
hybrid_rule.equity_weight: E = total CAP_DEF_M weight on the two equity groups (CN_LARGE {510300, 510050} and CN_MIDSMALL_GROWTH {510500, 159915}); E is 0, 1/3 or 2/3.
hybrid_rule.replacement: If E > 0: replace those equity holdings by the top 5 eligible sector ETFs by S5 score computed at the same signal session close, each with weight E/5. If fewer than 5 are eligible, split E equally among those available; if none is eligible, keep CAP_DEF_M's own equity ETF(s).
hybrid_rule.non_equity: Gold, bond (incl. DEF slots) and cash weights are exactly CAP_DEF_M's.
hybrid_rule.no_other_logic: No stop-loss, no trend filter on sectors, no extra parameters.

execution_model: As in sector_mom protocol: XSHG calendar, T+1, limit-blocked orders retry at each following open (10% limit, 20% for ETFs tracking ChiNext/STAR-based indices), SHIBOR 3M cash on uninvested cash, suspended (missing-bar) symbols valued at last close and rebalances postponed per cn_transfer amendment 1. Fractional shares, 1,000,000 CNY.

costs.primary: 2.5 bp commission + 10 bp slippage per side, applied to ALL strategies in this protocol

strategies.CAP_DEF_M_CN: frozen rule alone, run in this same engine with the same costs (the comparator for the primary question)
strategies.CN_60_40: 60% 510300 / 40% 511010, monthly on the same execution sessions
strategies.EW_SECTOR: as in sector_mom (monthly equal weight across eligible deduplicated sector ETFs)

phases.phase_1_dev_sanity: Run all strategies on DEV (2020-07-13..2024-09-30) only, to check the code. No decision depends on it; no parameter exists to tune. The guard stays active. Report it.
phases.phase_2_holdout_once: Only after the user's explicit go-ahead in chat. Run continuously from DEV start through 2026-09-30 and score the HOLDOUT slice (first session >= 2024-10-01 .. 2026-09-30). Implemented behind an explicit authorisation file written by the main session after the user's go-ahead, and a one-time state file recording that the holdout has been run; a second run must be refused.

success_criteria_holdout_primary_cost.primary: HYBRID excess Sharpe > CAP_DEF_M_CN excess Sharpe (point estimate) AND HYBRID max drawdown <= CAP_DEF_M_CN max drawdown + 5.0 pp
success_criteria_holdout_primary_cost.statistical: Report the stationary block bootstrap (block 21, 2000 resamples, seed 20261019) 90% CI of the excess Sharpe difference HYBRID - CAP_DEF_M_CN; if it includes 0 the result must be described as not statistically distinguishable.
success_criteria_holdout_primary_cost.robustness: Primary criterion also evaluated under the sensitivity cost; report whether it holds.

outcomes.SUPPORTED: primary criterion met under both costs
outcomes.WEAK: primary criterion met under primary cost only
outcomes.NOT_SUPPORTED: primary criterion not met under primary cost

success_criteria_holdout_primary_cost.secondary_reported_only: HYBRID vs CSI300_BH, CN_60_40, EW_SECTOR (not clean, see exposure_disclosure)

metrics: mean equity / gold / bond / cash weights
freeze_rule: Frozen once hashed. No changes after phase 1 output is seen except bug fixes that do not change any rule; any such fix is listed with its diff before phase 2.
